headlines.title: Trump Faces Intense Bipartisan Backlash Over Russian Oil Deal
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is facing growing bipartisan backlash following his announcement of a deal to temporarily lift U.S. sanctions on Russian diesel fuel. The move, aimed at lowering fuel prices in the United States ahead of the midterm elections, has members of Congress from both parties saying the deal may be illegal. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: RJ Mitte, actor best known for playing Walter White Jr. on ‘Breaking Bad,’ dies at 34
headlines.description: Actor RJ Mitte, known for playing the son of Walter White in the hit AMC series “Breaking Bad” and as an advocate for the rights of those with disabilities, has died at the age of 34, his representatives said Monday.

headlines.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's home in ongoing criminal probe
headlines.description: Federal agents conducted a search at the home of of Rep. Ilhan Omar, D-Minn., as part as an ongoing criminal probe. NBC News' Ryan Reilly has the early details on the investigation and the unusual timing of the action this close to an election.

headlines.title: Selma Blair arrested for allegedly assaulting two flight attendants
headlines.description: Actor Selma Blair has been arrested after allegedly assaulting two flight attendants. She was later taken to a hospital for evaluation after the flight landed in New York. NBC News' Sam Brock has the early details on the incident.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh Airport Hit With 2 Strikes in 2 Days
headlines.description: Videos show the moments Riyadh Airport, the main airport in Saudi Arabia, was hit in a deadly attack on Saturday and then again on Sunday, killing more than a dozen including one American. Now questions swirl about whether the United States will join airstrikes against the Iranian-backed Houthi militants responsible for the attacks, which would widen the U.S.-Iran conflict just weeks before the midterm elections. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Shane Gillis’ ‘SNL’ monologue slammed as sexist for comments about women
headlines.description: The comedian drew criticism online after he said women at the gym “just dress like whores now.”

headlines.title: Judge tears into Trump administration for felling trees on D.C. golf course the president wants to remake
headlines.description: “I’m furious,” U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes told a Justice Department lawyer. “I trusted you all not to do precisely what you have done.”

headlines.title: To counteract a spooky economy, America prepares to spend on Halloween candy
headlines.description: This Halloween, rising prices for groceries and gas are pushing many consumers to cut back. But they’re not giving up Halloween candy.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Trump says ‘we’re looking at’ firing Kimberly Guilfoyle, the U.S. ambassador to Greece
headlines.description: The president’s remarks come days after a Trump donor alleged Guilfoyle tried to get him to pay $100,000 to get rid of her credit card debt shortly before her confirmation hearing.

headlines.title: Chicago police find killer in 65-year-old cold case murder of little girl — one of their own
headlines.description: DNA technology that didn’t exist when Gloria Kowalewicz, 8, was killed in 1960 led investigators to Thomas F. McInerney Jr., who was a homicide detective for the Chicago Police Department.
